desc: Sui s a Layer 1 blockchain developed by Mysten Labs, a team founded by former lead engineers from Meta’s blockchain research division. It is designed for global adoption by providing a secure, high-speed environment for digital asset ownership and removing technical barriers for Web3 applications. The platform utilizes the Move programming language to create a safe framework and supports horizontal scaling to keep fees stable and speeds high as the network grows. Significant institutional support comes from major venture capital firms including Andreessen Horowitz, Coinbase Ventures, Circle Ventures, and YZi Labs. The system functions by organizing data into independent objects rather than a single ledger of accounts. This object-centric data model enables parallel execution, allowing the network to process many transactions simultaneously instead of waiting for one to finish before starting the next. This architecture is built for rapid transaction finalization to ensure near-instant results. To maintain long-term stability, the network collects fees into a storage fund that rewards validators for keeping data on the network indefinitely. …
